subject: How to create unmarkedMultFrame for data collected by two observers on two visits?

messages.author: d640f02d29e7de63
messages.subject: How to create unmarkedMultFrame for data collected by two observers on two visits?
parts:
Dear all,

My objective is to use gmultmix to fit models of bird abundance as a function of siteCovs while accounting for detection probability (no obsCovs are available).

My dataset contains abundance data for a single species collected by two observers (dependent double observer) on two occasions during a single year. Given this sampling regime, I am struggling to create an unmarkedMultFrame and the required obsToY and piFun objects for the dependent double observer protocol.

A subset of my data is attached (dat.csv) with the following structure:

> head(dat)
  Site y.1 y.2 y.3 y.4         Area Dist
1    1   0   0  NA  NA 0.0025266527    0
2    2   0   0  NA  NA 0.0156166046    0
3    3   1   0   0   0 0.0702678899    0
4    4   0   0  NA  NA 0.0099444691    0
5    5   0   0  NA  NA 0.0041464518    0
6    6   0   0  NA  NA 0.0007326132    0

Site is a unique site identifier.
y.1 and y.2 are counts collected by the primary (y.1) and secondary (y.2) observers on survey 1.
y.3 and y.4 are counts collected by the primary (y.3) and secondary (y.4) observers on survey 2.
Area and Dist are two site covariates.

I would appreciate any help or advice you could provide.

Many thanks!

Mark
